notes.title: New Patch - Codename Gamma
notes.content:
A new patch has just been pushed live for Ann Achronist: Many Happy Returns!

Changelog:

[list]
[*]Library pencil updated to a pen.
[*]Pink ribbon on baker ending, not white one.
[*]Crown jewel achievement now correctly unlocks (previously impossible).
[*]Splitting overflowing dialogue.
[*]Increased credits scroll speed, fixed logo distortion.
[*]Increased volume of whispers on psychic Ann start.
[*]Split Chiswick conversation for better skipping.
[*]Compressed sound effects and changed them to streaming, reducing memory usage.
[*]Compressed portraits, reducing memory usage.
[/list]

Although crashing has significantly reduced since the last patch, there are still minor issues (particularly on the mini games) that are causing crashes. This patch addresses some of those lingering causes. We will continue to investigate any crash reports.

Thanks for all your bug reports so far! Please let us know if you experience any issues and we will work on finding a solution as quickly as possible.

Until next time!
Maybe Later Games

[*]Compressed portraits, reducing memory usage.

notes.title: New Patch - Codename Beta
notes.content:
A new patch has just been pushed live for Ann Achronist: Many Happy Returns!

Changelog:

[list]
[*]Peter now always beckons you to his cart until that timeline is unlocked.
[*]Peter packs up his things at the right time when leaving due to 'a storm coming'.
[*]Graveyard incidental with Matt now only plays if you gave Matt a tomato
[*]Achievement added for completing the game
[*]Sought Things achievement removed
[*]On narrower monitors, clock no longer covers dialogue. 
[*]If conversation text would overflow the textbox, the font size is temporarily reduced.
[*]Closing the menu during a conversation now focuses back on the first conversation option
[/list]


A few players have experienced crashes linked to memory issues. Hopefully these have been tackled as part of this patch. We will continue to investigate any crash reports.

Thanks for all your bug reports so far! Please let us know if you experience any issues and we will work on finding a solution as quickly as possible.

Until next time
Maybe Later Games

notes.title: New Patch - Codename Alpha
notes.content:
A new patch has just been pushed live for Ann Achronist: Many Happy Returns!

Changelog: 
[list]
[*]Inventory close button now clickable
[*]Infinite convo loop at Truth or Dare fixed
[*]Matt no longer appears after leaving the bandits if you didn't already have him
[*]Bandit mindmap now properly despawns on runs after it has been solved
[*]Removed Remedio quest invitation until fully implemented at a later date

[*]Shortened path of first patrol guard to make hitboxes more obvious
[*]Mask sprite improved
[*]Remedio now has a hint for the heist
[*]Compressed music and character sprites
[/list]

A few players have experienced crashes linked to memory issues. Hopefully these have been tackled as part of this patch. We will continue to investigate any crash reports.

Thanks for all your bug reports so far! Please let us know if you experience any issues and we will work on finding a solution as quickly as possible.

Until next time
Maybe Later Games

[/list]

Thanks for all your bug reports so far! Please let us know if you experience any issues and we will work on finding a solution as quickly as possible.
